translations.web: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.
translations.bsb: If it is burned up, he will suffer loss. He himself will be saved, but only as if through the flames.
translations.kjv: If any man's work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.
translations.asv: If any man's work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as through fire.
